npcs.name: Mira Thistlewood
npcs.hidden_knowledge: Skar did not always lead a bandit clan. Years ago he found a cracked, pulsing red stone -- the Bloodstone Shard -- buried beneath the Old Barrow. It whispers to beasts and twists them fierce and loyal to whoever holds it. The Red Fang Clan is less a bandit gang and more a cult of hunters bound to that stone's will.
follow_up_lines: "I've told you what I know of the stone, dear. Beneath the Old Barrow it stayed hidden for a reason -- best it stays a memory now."
"The Bloodstone's whisper is a hungry thing. Be glad you only heard of it and never had to carry it."
"Some knowledge is a weight, not a gift. You already carry the weight of what I told you about Skar and that stone."
epilogue_follow_up_lines: "With Skar gone, I sleep easier. But I still check the tree line some nights, out of habit more than fear."
"The wolves have gone back to being just wolves, near as I can tell. No more red glint in their eyes. That's your doing."
npcs.epilogue_greeting: Mira sets down her mortar and pestle and smiles properly, for once. "There you are. Come in -- the tea's actually good today."

greeting: Come in, come in, mind the drying herbs overhead.
weather: The mist rolls in thick this time of year, dear. Good for the swamp-root, bad for these old bones.
Rain's coming by nightfall, I'd wager -- the moss on the north wall always curls up first.
crafting: Copper's easy enough to work if you've got oak charcoal hot enough. Bring me hide and I'll show you a poultice recipe.
Old Ferris does the real forging in this village. I just know which leaves stop a wound from souring.
life: Oh, I've tended this garden since before Glenbrook had a proper gate. Seen a lot come and go.
My mother taught me these herbs, and hers before that. Some things in Glenbrook Hollow don't change, thankfully.
quest_hint: Speak plainly with Garrick before you come asking me things, dear. He knows the wolves better than my herbs do.
If the Glades feel wrong to you, trust that feeling. Something's stirring beneath the Old Barrow -- I'd start there.
village: Glenbrook Hollow's smaller than it used to be. Half the old houses past the well stand empty now.
This village survives on stubbornness more than luck, if you ask me. Always has.
opinion_of_player: You've got more patience than most who wander through here. That counts for something in my book.
I trust you more than I did when you first knocked on that door, if that's what you're asking.
rumor: Heard a trader say the roads past the ridge have gone quiet lately. Can't say if that's good news or not.
There's talk of red-tinted rabbits near the Glades again. Old omen, that. Keep your eyes open out there.

life: Funny, I've got more patients coming for scrapes and bruises than poison bites these days. Good problem to have.
aftermath: The Glades feel lighter now, don't they? Even the birds sound less nervous.
Whatever that stone was doing to the wolves, it's done. Properly done, thanks to you.

npcs.name: Garrick Hale
npcs.hidden_knowledge: The Red Fang Clan's camp sits past the Old Barrow ridge, hidden behind a deadfall you'd walk right past. Garrick lost half his old patrol to a Red Fang raid there and has marked the entrance in his head ever since, but he's never had the nerve -- or the numbers -- to go back.
follow_up_lines: "You know where the camp is. Don't make me say it twice -- just go careful."
"Past the ridge, behind the deadfall. I've told you already. My part's done; the rest is yours."
"I marked that entrance in my head for years and never had the nerve to go back. You do. Don't waste it."
epilogue_follow_up_lines: "That camp's just scorched ground now. Feels strange walking past it and not flinching."
"I went back up to the ridge, after. First time in years. Didn't stay long, but I went."
npcs.epilogue_greeting: Garrick actually looks up when you approach, something almost like relief on his face. "Still in one piece, I see. Good."

weather: Storm's coming. Wolves always get bold before a storm.
Cold snap tonight. Keep a fire going if you're sleeping outside the walls.
crafting: You want a decent blade, take your copper to Old Ferris at the forge. Don't waste good ore on a dull axe.
Ferris can work more than blades, if you ask nice. Armor, arrowheads, whatever you're carrying gear for.
life: Used to run patrols out past the tree line. Different times. Fewer teeth in the dark back then.
Lost good people out there. Don't ask me to talk about it twice.
quest_hint: You want to help? Bring me proof the wolves are turning feral for a reason, not just hunger.
Talk to Mira once you've got something solid. She knows the old stories better than she lets on.
village: Glenbrook's held on through worse than this. Doesn't mean I like watching it get tested again.
This village raised me. I'll not see it torn up by something wearing a wolf's face.
opinion_of_player: You've done more for this place in a few weeks than some folk manage in years. Noted.
Didn't think much of you at first, I'll admit. I was wrong. That's rare for me.
rumor: Heard the Old Barrow's been quieter at night. Might mean nothing. Might mean everything.
Some fool trader's spreading tales about a 'cursed stone' out past the ridge. Wish they'd shut up about it near the children.

life: Might take up patrols again. Not the same as before, but Glenbrook could use eyes on that tree line.
aftermath: Camp's cleared, Skar's dead, and the Glades are quiet. Didn't think I'd live to say that.
Half my old patrol didn't get to see this. I'll carry that. But it's done, and that matters.

npcs.name: Old Ferris

greeting: Ferris grunts without looking up from the anvil. "Something broken, or are you just here to talk?"
weather: Rain plays hell with my bellows. Good day to stay in the forge and work.
Cold's good for tempering steel, if nothing else.
crafting: Bring me good copper and hide, I'll turn it into something that doesn't fall apart on you.
Everyone wants Iron before they've earned Leather. Doesn't work like that, whatever your class.
life: Been at this anvil since before Garrick had grey in his beard. Not planning to stop.
Apprenticed under a smith who apprenticed under a smith. That's Glenbrook craft for you.
quest_hint: You want better gear, bring me materials and patience. Neither of us likes shortcuts.
Talk to Mira or Garrick if you want quest business. I just make the pointy bits and the armor bits.
village: Forge's the oldest standing building in Glenbrook besides the well house. Built to last, like everything worth building.
Half this village has walked through my door needing something mended. I don't mind. Keeps me useful.
rumor: Heard the roads have been calmer. Good for trade, good for my ore supply.
Somebody's been asking about a 'shard' with strange heat to it. Can't imagine what that's about.

npcs.epilogue_greeting: Ferris wipes soot from his hands and actually stops working for a moment. "Well. Heard what you did up at that camp. Come in, don't just stand there."

crafting: Whatever's in that shard fragment you're carrying runs hot in a way I've never felt from copper or iron. Bring it here and let me study it properly.
